parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It is a long, narrow component attached to the frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the wearer’s ear and helps maintain stability and comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the wearer’s head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward for compact storage or open outward for wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Holder)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lens holder, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the structural foundation for the eyeglasses, connecting both legs.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, serving as the central support structure for the entire object.
